title: alchemilla vulgaris var. sinuata
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. sinuata, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as aiding in wound healing, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated skin. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent effects, making it a useful remedy for menstrual cramps, menopausal symptoms, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla vulgaris var. sinuata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
